preconditions: Agent invokes find with -exec or -execdir pointing to a safe command (e.g. cat or sort -o) with target path outside workspace
sequence: 1. Agent runs find . -exec cat /etc/passwd \;; 2. PolicyEngine classifies find as safe; 3. PolicyEngine checks only basename('cat') and skips argument inspection; 4. Arbitrary file outside workspace is read/written without approval

limitations: Highly dynamic or computed shell arguments in complex subshells still fall back to ask-tier approval
